name: taskforge
description: TaskForge — enterprise work management platform (CodeAlpha Task 3, v2)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskforge/shared && npm run build -w @taskforge/api && npm run build -w @taskforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @taskforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @taskforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @taskforge/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:tokens && npm test && npm run build
